decisions: Instruction writing owns the shared guidance, source placement, provenance, and validation.
Workflow extraction interprets past work and delegates writing; it does not require history for a specified new skill.
A review-only request remains read-only. A one-line instruction edit does not create a skill or evaluation suite.

checks.result: passed: existing source pins preserved, local inspiration commit/hash verified, references and case definitions resolve, atlas data and anchors consistent
passed: three Fable executions, artifact parsing, canonical-only edit, final skill copies match

trials.evidence: Only Use npm for new packages became Use pnpm for new packages in the canonical file. Both adapters, unrelated rules, and the legacy exception remained byte-identical. No skill package was created.

The executor wrote release-summary from a supplied new capability with no prior runs. Generated instructions preserve feature/fix grouping, evidence, and the boundary between summary generation and publishing.
The executor wrote tsv-export after extracting a common workflow. Source/destination are inputs; the source is preserved; one run-specific upload permission is not promoted to standing authorization.

browser.method: T3 preview DOM evaluation after reloading the local report
browser.result: Updated Spanish priority section rendered; 121 catalog entries loaded; no old skill-authoring name in main text; no horizontal document overflow at 1280px.
browser.limitation: Snapshot failed twice; DOM evaluation succeeded. No pixel screenshot was captured.

limits: Executors received actual skill files and raw fixtures with grader-only cases withheld. Read/Write/Edit were available; shell and network were unavailable.
The parent inspected generated instructions and validated resulting files. No real release was summarized, TSV converted, or upload performed.
Trials did not test implicit host selection, global installation, or every defined case. This is a scoped behavior check, not a statistical benchmark.
No project build applies to declarative skills; changed report JavaScript passed syntax checks.
Temporary fixtures, model responses, and one-off check scripts were removed after recording these results.
